description: 繁體中文：Nivqo v1.33.0 同版覆蓋更新，內建 HushFacebook 0.6.0-nivqo.1 與 HushMessenger 0.14.0-nivqo.1 正式核心。HushMessenger 只同步上游正式 v0.14.0，共 32 個 patch，核心設定繁中 203 / 203，Manager patch metadata 32 / 32；新增聊天滑入滑出動畫、Native Bubbles、側邊選單設定入口、手機原生 Emoji，並納入 v0.8.0～v0.14.0 的備份、Root Mount、更新檢查與穩定性修正。App 顯示版本仍為 1.33.0；v1.32.0 與舊 v1.33.0 可直接覆蓋更新。 English: Same-version Nivqo v1.33.0 replacement with bundled HushFacebook 0.6.0-nivqo.1 and HushMessenger 0.14.0-nivqo.1 formal cores. HushMessenger syncs only the formal upstream v0.14.0 release, has 32 patches, 203 / 203 Traditional Chinese core settings strings, and 32 / 32 localized Manager patch metadata. It adds the chat slide animation, Native Bubbles, side-menu settings access, phone-native emoji, and the v0.8.0–v0.14.0 backup, Root Mount, update-check and reliability improvements. The installed version name remains 1.33.0 and existing v1.32.0 / older v1.33.0 builds can update in place.
